question: Which of the following is NOT an Alicyclic compound?
solution:
The correct answer is** Isobutane.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Isobutane** is not an **Alicyclic compound**.
 
• Alicyclic compounds are compounds containing one or more carbon rings, but unlike aromatic compounds, they may not have alternating single and double bonds. They can be saturated (cycloalkanes) or unsaturated (cycloalkenes or cycloalkynes).
 
• Cyclohexane: This is an alicyclic compound as it contains a ring structure without any double bonds or aromatic characteristics.
